session: Your KeeperHub session ended. Connect KeeperHub to continue.
server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
bad_request: That request could not be read.
upstream_error: KeeperHub didn't answer as expected. Try again in a moment.
transport: KeeperHub couldn't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
rate_limited: KeeperHub is busy. Try again in a moment.
insufficient_scope: This needs more access to KeeperHub. Reconnect and allow it.
archived: This conversation was archived. Start a new chat.
waiting: Answer the card or form above first.
not_shareable: Only an action that executed with a transaction can be shared.
validation_failed: Some details don't fit. Check them and try again.
write_not_available: This action can't be sent from here yet.
quarantined: This action can't be run: the Copilot can't establish what it does.
automation_only: KeeperHub runs this only as a step inside an automation.
deactivated: This automation is switched off in KeeperHub.
on_demand: This automation runs only when it is started.
